summary: {attendant} prices the adults and children separately when a family asks what one afternoon at the pool will cost.
realLife: Portland's pool schedule listed different admission prices by age and admitted children younger than three without charge.
gates: The local government runs the recreation service and is considering or implementing a change to its fee.
inGame: The park fee series supplies the jurisdiction's change in the charge level. needs: party ages, age-specific admission rules and the rate in force.

turns.pulledBy: An adult admission rises while the youngest child remains free.
turns.what: The attendant shows the family which admission changed.
turns.writesBack: The receipt lists the paid entries.

turns.pulledBy: A lower youth rate brings the family's visit within budget.
turns.what: The family buys the admissions it needs.
turns.writesBack: The count records the free child separately.
